name: contactlift
description: ContactLift Smart Contact Bar and ContactLift Pro.
author: Muhammad Ali Ilyas <hi@m-ali.dev> (https://m-ali.dev)

scripts.makepot:free: wp-env run cli -- wp i18n make-pot /var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/contactlift /var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/contactlift/languages/contactlift.pot --slug=contactlift --domain=contactlift
scripts.makepot:pro: wp-env run cli -- wp i18n make-pot /var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/contactlift-pro /var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/contactlift-pro/languages/contactlift-pro.pot --slug=contactlift-pro --domain=contactlift-pro
